people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”
translations.bsb: So Simon Peter motioned to him to ask Jesus which one He was talking about.
translations.kjv: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.
translations.asv: Simon Peter therefore beckoneth to him, and saith unto him, Tell us who it is of whom he speaketh.
